lines.beaver_en: Minji, want to go to the reunion together?
lines.learner: 동창회? 사실 난 좀 가기 꺼려져.
lines.en: The reunion? Honestly, I'm a bit reluctant to go.
lines.roman: Dongchanghoe? Sasil nan jom gagi kkeoryeojyeo.

lines.beaver: 왜? 다들 너 보고 싶어 해. 거절해도 되긴 하지만.
lines.beaver_en: Why? Everyone misses you. You can say no, though.
lines.beaver_roman: Wae? Dadeul neo bogo sipeo hae. Geojeolhaedo doegin hajiman.
lines.learner: 내심 가고 싶은데 마음이 잘 안 내켜.
lines.en: Deep down I want to go, but I don't feel like it.
lines.roman: Naesim gago sipeunde maeumi jal an naekyeo.

lines.beaver: 무슨 이유가 있어? 좀 더 얘기해 줄래?
lines.beaver_en: Is there a reason? Can you tell me more?
lines.beaver_roman: Museun iyuga isseo? Jom deo yaegihae jullae?
lines.en: I think it'll be awkward after so long.

lines.beaver: 그렇구나. 사람들 만나는 게 부담이 크겠다.
lines.beaver_en: I see. Meeting people must be a big burden.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureokuna. Saramdeul mannaneun ge budami keugetda.
lines.en: Yeah, I've been lethargic, so the pressure is big too.

lines.beaver_en: Has work been hard lately? I'm worried.
lines.en: Since I quit my job, I feel deflated and empty.

lines.beaver: 그래서 친구들 앞에 서기가 힘든 거구나.
lines.beaver_en: So that's why it's hard to face your friends.
lines.beaver_roman: Geuraeseo chingudeul ape seogiga himdeun geoguna.
lines.learner: 동정 받을까 봐 엄두가 안 나.
lines.en: I'm afraid of being pitied, so I can't bring myself to go.
lines.roman: Dongjeong badeulkka bwa eomduga an na.

lines.beaver: 아무도 너를 그렇게 안 볼 거야. 걱정 마.
lines.beaver_en: Nobody will see you that way. Don't worry.
lines.beaver_roman: Amudo neoreul geureoke an bol kkeoya. Geokjeong ma.
lines.learner: 알아. 그래도 마음이 걸려서 며칠 고민했어.
lines.en: I know. Still, it bothered me, so I thought it over for days.
lines.roman: Ara. Geuraedo maeumi geollyeoseo myeochil gominhaesseo.

lines.beaver: 우리 학교에 대한 애착은 아직 있지?
lines.beaver_en: You still feel attached to our school, right?
lines.beaver_roman: Uri hakgyoe daehan aechageun ajik itji?
lines.en: Yes, thinking of it still makes me wistful.

lines.beaver: 그럼 한 시간만 와서 얼굴 보는 건 어때?
lines.beaver_en: Then how about coming for just an hour to say hi?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom han siganman waseo eolgul boneun geon eottae?
lines.en: Okay. If I keep talking with friends, I'll feel better.

lines.beaver: 고마워! 내가 옆에 꼭 붙어 있을게.
lines.beaver_en: Thanks! I'll stay right by your side.
lines.beaver_roman: Gomawo! Naega yeope kkok buteo isseulge.
lines.learner: 고마워. 거부감도 조금씩 줄어들 것 같아.
lines.en: Thank you. I think my resistance will fade little by little.
lines.roman: Gomawo. Geobugamdo jogeumssik jureodeul kkeot gata.
